name: Evergy
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public evergy.com pages (read in a browser, no sign-in). Log In asks for Username and Password (no email login described); registration needs the account number. No pay-without-signing-in option is offered: the Payment Options page lists only logged-in online payment, the public Pay My Bill link redirects to Log In, and the login page's 'Continue as Guest' link returns to the home page (reviewer re-checked 2026-10-10), so guest_pay is unsupported (observed_public) with phone/mail/in-person alternatives. Auto Pay is processed on the due date and can be updated or cancelled anytime in My Account; payment methods for Auto Pay are not stated, so the family default methods stay. No card convenience fee is stated on the Payment Options page; a 2021 Kansas Central tariff says residential card payments carry no fee (not read), so fees are left out. Phone payments by Visa/Mastercard or check, weekdays 7 am-5 pm. Payment Plans & Extensions (installment plans, payment extensions, adjustable due dates) are handled in My Account; Average Payment Plan spreads costs over 12 months. Paperless has a public enrollment form (not submitted). Stop service is online through Start, Stop or Move.

guest_pay.note: To pay online, log in to your Evergy account. Without logging in, pay by phone at 1-888-471-5275, by mail with your bill's return envelope, or at an Evergy Connect location or kiosk.

autopay.note: Auto Pay is processed on your due date. You can update or cancel it anytime.

help.title: Payment Options
paragraphs: Log in to your online account to pay anytime; registering is free. You can also pay in the Evergy app or with text commands.

By phone, call 1-888-471-5275 and follow the prompts. Pay by check with your account number and checkbook ready, or by Visa or Mastercard with your card number; phone payments are taken weekdays 7 am to 5 pm, except holidays.
By mail, send a check or money order in the return envelope from your bill. In person, visit an Evergy Connect location or a self-service kiosk.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay processes your payment automatically on your due date so you avoid late payments. You can update or cancel it anytime from your account preferences.
steps: Turn on Auto Pay and choose your payment method.

help.title: Payment plans and energy assistance
paragraphs: Payment Plans & Extensions: if you qualify, align your due date with your income schedule, pay down a balance over time with an installment plan, or get extra time to pay a bill. Start from My Account.
Average Payment Plan spreads your energy costs over the year based on your last 12 months of usage; the amount adjusts as your usage changes.
If you are having trouble keeping up with your bills, the Energy Assistance page lists programs you may qualify for.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Paperless billing (residential customers) replaces your paper bill with email or text notices and reminders and keeps your bill and payment history online. The full bill is available only in your online account or app.
It can take up to one billing cycle to take effect. You can turn it off anytime under Preferences in your account.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Use Start, Stop or Move online. Choose Stop if you are leaving Evergy's service area, or Move if you are moving within it. On the stop date, unlock gates and secure pets so the meter can be reached.

help.title: View your bill
paragraphs: Log in to your account or the Evergy app to see your current bill, payment history and account information.

help.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: You can combine payment options, for example Auto Pay with the Average Payment Plan.
Registering for online access is free; you need your account number to register.
